description: Functional specification: preserve global API/token charts, add sortable top-five models and people tables, and an agent dropdown with API/token charts filtered by configured agent. Range and 15s refresh apply throughout; selected agent and sorts persist; loading/empty/error states. Reuse BOLayout, DesignSystem table/form controls and BOTelemetryComponents. BO calls Engine through NodeRouter dispatch contract, not generic invoke. Tests first: LiveView rendering/events/state preservation and global charts unaffected. Action reuse: reuse telemetry context and existing components; no new Action. E2E journey is deferred to zaq-uy9-e2e pending final UX approval.

comments.text: Implemented Engine dispatch action, LiveView rankings with independent token/call sorts, configured-agent selector and filtered call/token charts while preserving global charts and range/refresh state. Reused DS table/button/select and BO telemetry charts. Targeted suite passes (84 tests, 2 properties); mix q passes after one transient unrelated parallel component-check failure. Browser route is available at port 4011 but redirects to BO login, so final authenticated UX review remains in zaq-uy9.4.

Addressed human review feedback. Retrieval effectiveness now renders immediately below global API/token charts. API-call history now combines legacy request estimates with exact attributed calls per 10-minute bucket: new metrics carry llm_usage_attribution=v1 so their request totals are excluded; unversioned overlap uses max(legacy requests, explicit calls), avoiding both the observed reset and additive double-counting. Regression coverage includes legacy-to-versioned transition and mixed same-bucket overlap. Targeted: 87 tests, 2 properties pass; mix q passes.
